messages:
Anna PM: quick thought — for tenants with hundreds of routes we should add a compact role-heatmap "mini-map" on the Roles page so admins can spot weird grant clustering and quota hot spots
Liam: can you sketch what you mean? is this purely visual or does it link into routing/quotas telemetry?
Anna PM: short version: small grid overlay (route x role) with color intensity = normalized token usage or denied attempts. clicking a cell drills into the route's policy + recent rollouts. mostly visual entrypoint to existing telemetry
Maria (Design): I like the drill pattern. need to avoid exposing raw counts (privacy) — suggest intensity = percentile band (0-5) and show a sampled tooltip on hover, not raw numbers
Kevin (Security): +1 on no raw counts. also need to be explicit about what data is aggregated. if this gets shipped to private installs we should make aggregation configurable and default to local-only metrics (no cross-tenant aggregation)
Sophie: implementation note: we already emit per-route token stats in the console telemetry stream (route_usage.v1). We can add a small aggregator in the frontend that requests `GET /admin/telemetry/roles/heat` with ?window=7d and ?bucket=percentile
Liam: internal API debate: do we want a new endpoint or reuse route-usage and compute client-side? client-side means more bandwidth but faster iteration; server-side lets us centralize sampling/aggregation and avoid putting PII in clients
Anna PM: prefer server-side with opt-in sampling flags per-tenant. UX should show a tiny disclosure: "aggregated metrics enabled" and link to controls
Maria (Design): microcopy for disclosure: "Aggregated role heatmap (non-identifying, sampled). Admins can disable in Settings > Telemetry." keeps it short
Kevin (Security): add an audit event when a tenant toggles aggregation. make sure we have KMS-backed storage for any retained raw telemetry and a TTL (default 30d)
Sophie: FYI we'll need a small ingest change to tag role/route pairs and a sampler that keeps 1% by default. Ops: we can route heavy tenants to Dedicated aggregator to avoid load on the hosted pipeline
Liam: implementation plan proposal: server endpoint `/admin/roles/heatmap?v=1&window=7d&mode=percentile` returns compressed buckets + meta. frontend renders grid, clicking cell fetches `/admin/routes/{id}/policy-audit?since=7d`
Anna PM: sounds good. follow-ups — Maria will mock up compact visuals; Liam & Sophie draft endpoint contract; Kevin writes the security checklist; I'll own the rollout plan and opt-in copy
Maria (Design): attaching quick ascii mock in thread: ```
[roles] [mini-heatmap grid] [legend]
hover -> tooltip: "75th pct token use (sampled)"
```
DevOps Bot: deploy pipeline note: "staging: heatmap-api v1 scheduled for canary on 3060003000" :rocket:
Liam: can we add a telemetry event for "heatmap_cell_click" (route_id, role_id, tenant_id hash) so we can measure usefulness before full rollout
Kevin (Security): tenant_id must be hashed and salted, store salt in per-tenant KMS. approve event schema after Liam posts draft
Anna PM: thanks — next sync Friday 10am. I'll drop an agenda and link to Maria's mocks. :thumbsup:
